silver gull.migratory_status: 留鳥 / 城鎮近海游動
silver gull.habit: 雜食性，強烈適應人類城鎮、港口碼頭、廢棄物堆置場與露天餐廳，社會性高度群聚。
silver gull.habit_en: Omnivorous, highly adapted to human urban environments, ports, landfills, and open dining areas. Densely gregarious.
silver gull.risk_note: 極易在野外濕地與人類城鎮間穿梭，最容易將野外病毒攜入城鎮或飼料存放區，為重點監控對象。
silver gull.risk_note_en: Frequent bridge vector between wild wetlands and urban/feed areas. Primary biosecurity monitoring target.

crested tern.habit: 專一食魚，極度偏好在沿海沙洲與外島進行數千隻規模的高密度密集群聚繁殖。
crested tern.habit_en: Piscivorous, nests in dense breeding colonies of thousands on offshore islands and sandbars.
crested tern.risk_note: 易在沿海棲地引發超級傳播與大規模死亡（南澳與維州海岸主因），但極少深入內陸高地。
crested tern.risk_note_en: Prone to mass mortality events in coastal breeding colonies (SA & VIC coastlines), but rarely strays inland.

brown skua.habit: 強悍掠食與腐食性，羽翼極強，可隨南半球西風帶進行數千公里遠洋長途跨洲飛行。
brown skua.habit_en: Aggressive predatory and scavenging pelagic seabird. Capable of long-distance transoceanic flights.
brown skua.risk_note: 將南極/亞南極病毒向北帶至澳洲南部島嶼（8/13 塔斯馬尼亞 Rocky Cape 首例即為棕賊鷗）。
brown skua.risk_note_en: Carries Antarctic/Sub-Antarctic strains north to southern Australian offshore islands (e.g. Rocky Cape, TAS).

little penguin.habit: 棲息於澳洲南部海岸與外島（如菲利普島 Phillip Island），不具飛行能力，夜間歸巢。
little penguin.habit_en: Inhabits southern Australian coastlines and offshore islands (e.g. Phillip Island). Flightless, nocturnal burrower.
little penguin.risk_note: 活動範圍嚴格限制於沿岸近海，無法飛行跨區傳播，主要為受害宿主。
little penguin.risk_note_en: Strictly marine and coastal habitat. Flightless, primary role is susceptible sentinel host.

pacific gull.habit: 大型海鷗，專門棲息於基岩海岸與沙灘，以甲殼類與魚類為食。
pacific gull.habit_en: Large endemic gull inhabiting rocky coasts and beaches, feeding on crabs and fish.
pacific gull.risk_note: 活動集中於沿岸棲地，鮮少進入內陸高地。
pacific gull.risk_note_en: Confined strictly to coastal shorelines, rarely strays inland.

giant petrel.name_zh: 巨鸌類 (Giant Petrel / 南方巨鸌)
giant petrel.habit: 大型遠洋掠食海鳥，經常跟隨漁船吃腐肉或於外海巡遊。
giant petrel.habit_en: Large pelagic seabird following fishing vessels and scavenging on oceanic waters.
giant petrel.risk_note: 長距離沿海巡遊能力強，容易因掠食染病海鳥而帶毒。
giant petrel.risk_note_en: High pelagic range, susceptible to carrying virus via scavenging infected seabirds.

fur seal.name_zh: 海獅/海豹 (Fur Seal / Sea Lion)
fur seal.migratory_status: 海洋哺乳類 / 沿岸群聚
fur seal.habit: 海洋肉食哺乳動物，棲息於澳洲南部岩岸與島嶼，密集群聚繁殖。
fur seal.habit_en: Carnivorous marine mammal inhabiting southern rocky shores and islands. Densely colonial breeder.
fur seal.risk_level: 🟠 哺乳類跨種傳播風險 (Mammal Risk)
fur seal.risk_note: 極易與受感染海鳥接觸並發生哺乳類跨種傳播，為生物安全重點警戒標的。
fur seal.risk_note_en: High susceptibility to avian influenza spillover from infected seabird colonies. Critical sentinel.

黑面鸕鶿 / cormorant.risk_note: 官方最新通報物種，建議密切關注其棲息地與活動動向。
